scenario.summary: The developer test testAllowNaN verifies that the JSON parser can parse the non-standard numeric token NaN when the feature ALLOW_NON_NUMERIC_NUMBERS is enabled. It checks that without the feature an exception is thrown, and with the feature the token is VALUE_NUMBER_FLOAT, getDoubleValue returns Double.NaN, and getDecimalValue fails with NumberFormatException. It also checks skipping works.
scenario.input_preconditions: Use the setup, arguments, fixtures, and state shown in generated_test.source_text for com.fasterxml.jackson.core.json.TestParserNonStandard::testAllowNaN.
scenario.expected_observation: The explicit assertions, expected exceptions, and state checks described by the declared scenario must be established by the generated test.
